svg.aria-label: S15 The FP and SIMD register file, and the flags file, register by register
svg.text: S15 The FP and SIMD register file, and the flags file, register by register
A register is a cell the player labels and marks ready. The 432 FP and SIMD registers are one file, since no bank count is published. The flags files and the free lists sit beside it.
Registers run row by row, r0 to r431.
Empty cells mean nothing else is in flight.
◆ Scalar and SIMD flags are separate files.
A register pops at rename and pushes back at retire.
It returns when its successor retires.
KB: fp_prf.total, fp_prf.headroom, flags_prf.total, flags_prf.headroom, split_flag_files
~ inferred: patent reading or author reasoning
